question: Under what minimal condition is that entity called the supreme Śiva at the time of departure?
premises: The entity in question is the one previously identified.
The condition given is merely the leaving of the body.
Upon that condition, it is called the supreme Śiva.
inference: Upon merely leaving the body, he is called the supreme Śiva.
uncertainties: Whether this is a statement of identity or of designation is not resolved here.
plain_english: Upon merely leaving the body, he is called the supreme Śiva.
